BackstoryDef.title: Immulsion Miner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] had one of the worst jobs of all, mining immulsion to fuel [PAWN_possessive] nations power demands.\n\nFending off attacks by various underground monsters and dealing with the longterm effects of immulsion fume inhalation has left [PAWN_possessive] body damaged and sickly.

BackstoryDef.title: Conscript Gear
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was one of the many citizens to be conscripted during the Coalitions time of need, [PAWN_pronoun] always knew this day could come but had never quite been ready for it.\n\n[PAWN_nameDef] had alot less training then [PAWN_pronoun] wanted, and far less training then [PAWN_pronoun] needed.

BackstoryDef.title: Patriot Gear
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] didnt wait to be asked, [PAWN_pronoun] signed up to join the C.O.Gs armed forces the moment [PAWN_pronoun] was of age.\n\n[PAWN_nameDef] is seen by The C.O.G as the prime example of what a citizen should be, and as little more then a pathetic dog by the C.O.G's enemies.

BackstoryDef.title: Penal Gear
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent a long time in prison, and under normal circumstances would have had to wait [PAWN_possessive] sentence but the C.O.G needed soldiers, and cared little about where they came from. [PAWN_nameDef] and many other prisoners were released early to serve as strong albeit poorly disciplined reinforcements to the frontline.

BackstoryDef.title: Former Thrashball
BackstoryDef.description: Thrashball, a sport so important to the C.O.G that even during wartime games are held in any city they can be to boost morale, [PAWN_nameDef] was one of many players looking for fame and fortune.\n\nAfter a particularly brutal attack on [PAWN_possessive] home town, [PAWN_pronoun] decided to enlist in the army instead of extending [PAWN_possessive] contract and urged others to do the same.

BackstoryDef.title: Thrashball Fullback
BackstoryDef.description: Thrashball, a sport so important to the C.O.G that even during wartime games are held in any city they can be to boost morale, [PAWN_nameDef] was a Fullback, tasked with intercepting enemy throws and passing the ball back to [PAWN_possessive] team mates.

BackstoryDef.title: Thrashball Linemen
BackstoryDef.description: Thrashball, a sport so important to the C.O.G that even during wartime games are held in any city they can be to boost morale, [PAWN_nameDef] was a Linemen, spending [PAWN_possessive] time blocking the enemy team from advancing, and suffering repeated collisions to [PAWN_possessive] head in the process.

li.label: Thrashballer
li.description: Thrashball teachs you 2 things, run fast, and not to flinch when someone hits you.
